correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the edge-restricted degree enumerator by contracting ij in the tree sum with edge weight x_u x_v. The two available attachments to a remaining vertex combine into weight (x_i+x_j)x_v. Prüfer enumeration on the contracted labels and division by the product of original vertex weights give (x_i+x_j)(Σx)^(n−3); n=2 is immediate. If q_i=2^(−degree(i)), then for i≠j the conditional mixed joint probability is q_i q_j(1+1_ij), and the same-type joint probability is q_i q_j(1−1_ij); on the diagonal the mixed joint probability is zero. Unrestricted and restricted Prüfer weights give E q_i=d_n/2, E q_i q_j=c_n/4 and E[q_i q_j 1_ij]=c_n/[4(n−1)]. Summing gives the stated formulas for covariance and variance. The ratio c_n/d_n²=(1−(2n−1)^(-2))^(n−2) is greater than (n−1)/n by Bernoulli's inequality and less than one for n≥3. The 1/n coefficients in c_n and d_n² relative to e^(-1) are 3/2 and 7/4, giving all three limits, with a positive limiting scaled variance. At n=2 both counts are constant, so only the covariance, not a finite-n correlation, is asserted there. On a fixed path with n≥3 the shared-edge and same-label terms give (n−4)/16. An independent connected-edge-subset enumeration with /workspace/review_replay.py checks exact rational moments at n=2–5; the frozen Prüfer verifier is finite corroboration, not the all-n proof.

value.rationale: The labels and null model are canonical. Exact strict positive mixed association at every unequal label pair can misleadingly suggest positively associated counts. The exact cancellation with the equal-label exclusion proves the opposite at every nondegenerate order and quantifies its surviving linear scale, with a different sign from a fixed path. This is a substantive finite-to-asymptotic comparison rather than re-evaluation of a deterministically oriented tree.
